id: \bHello there.\nWould you like to hear about my Braviary?
en: \bHello there.\nWould you like to hear about my Braviary?
it: \bSalve.\nTi va di sentire del mio Braviary?

id: \bWell lets see... he is smart, loyal, and all around just perfect.
en: \bWell lets see... he is smart, loyal, and all around just perfect.
it: \bAllora, vediamo... è intelligente, leale e, insomma, semplicemente perfetto.

id: \bThank you for listening to that. You can have this; it's no trouble. I am a bit too old to be using it.
en: \bThank you for listening to that. You can have this; it's no trouble. I am a bit too old to be using it.
it: \bGrazie per avermi ascoltato. Tieni, prendi questo; non è un problema. Sono un po' troppo vecchio per usarlo.

id: \bDid you come to hear about my Pokémon again?
en: \bDid you come to hear about my Pokémon again?
it: \bSei venuto di nuovo a sentir parlare del mio Pokémon?

id: \rYou're a Trainer, aren't you?\nCome see me when you beat the Gym Leader of this town.
en: \rYou're a Trainer, aren't you?\nCome see me when you beat the Gym Leader of this town.
it: \rSei un Allenatore, vero?\nVieni da me quando avrai battuto il Capopalestra di questa città.

id: \rGood job on defeating him! Take this for your efforts.
en: \rGood job on defeating him! Take this for your efforts.
it: \rBel lavoro, l'hai sconfitto! Prendi questo per il tuo impegno.

id: \rI'm not sure what it does. Keeps away wild Pokémon maybe?
en: \rI'm not sure what it does. Keeps away wild Pokémon maybe?
it: \rNon so bene a cosa serva. Forse tiene lontani i Pokémon selvatici?

id: \bMy Leavanny is so elegant. I bet no one else around has one better.
en: \bMy Leavanny is so elegant. I bet no one else around has one better.
it: \bIl mio Leavanny è così elegante. Scommetto che qui in giro nessuno ne ha uno migliore.
